title: Accelerator onboarding capacity snapshots and order-scaling plan
content:
Purpose:
Quick-running capacity snapshot and scaling playbook for onboarding new accelerator SKUs into the fleet. Intended as a working sheet for infra/product/product-ops alignment before an order tranche is committed.

Summary of current state (2025-09-03 snapshot):
- Active pool: 3,120 passthrough GPUs across regions (A100-80GB equiv).
- Committed incoming: 720 units from Vendor X (tranche A, ETA 12-14 weeks).
- On-order tentative: 480 mixed SKUs (Vendor Y, ETA 20-28 weeks) not yet approved.
- Target steady-state utilization: 65% token throughput target (SLO margin at 75%).

Regional allocation (working target):
- us-west: 42% (primary low-latency region)
- us-east: 33%
- eu-west: 18%
- apac: 7% (conservative for now, increase when regional nodes come online)

SKU mix assumptions (by capacity equivalence):
- High-density (H100-80GB-class): 48% of new capacity — strong perf for RLHF/serving heavy models.
- Cost-optimized (L40/FP16-quantized profiles): 30% — batch/embedding jobs.
- Balanced (A100-80GB/older H variants): 22% — fallback and regional backstop.

Lead times and vendor considerations (notes):
- Vendor X (preferred): 12-14 weeks confirmed; 8% chance of +2 week slip due to customs in EU.
- Vendor Y: 20-28 weeks; pricing edge but longer lead time. Keep as second-stage fill only.
- Spot/lease brokers: 1-4 weeks to spin; higher volatility but useful for 6-8 week shortfalls.

Procurement pipeline stages (working flow):
1) Demand signal (SRE/Product triggers: +8% sustained utilization or forecasted marketing event).
2) SKU bucketization (match workload to H100/L40/A100 buckets).
3) Pre-commit approval (finance + infra sign-off for tranche size and budget).
4) Place order (Vendor X preferred; negotiate staging deliveries).
5) Acceptance & staging (2–5 days for racking, burn-in).
6) Canary capacity release (10% of tranche for live validation).
7) Full autoscale enable and telemetry ramp.

Simulation excerpts (quick scenarios):
- Base: no new orders, 65% utilization target maintained by autoscaling -> risk window opens in week 18 due to expected growth delta (+15%).
- Fast growth (marketing spike, +30% token demand): need ~1,100 A100-eq additional capacity to maintain 65% util. -> translates to 13–15 weeks lead with Vendor X booking; immediate short-term fill via 300 leased GPUs (2–4 week) + reorder.
- Vendor slip (Vendor X +3 weeks): rolling shortage in eu-west; mitigation: redirect 40% of eu-west traffic to us-west, enable quantized L40 paths for embedding-heavy endpoints.

Reorder triggers (operational rules):
- Soft trigger: 60% sustained util over trailing 4 weeks -> open procurement conversation (SLO: approval within 7 business days).
- Hard trigger: 68% sustained util or <4 weeks of buffer capacity -> auto-escalate to exec procurement and finance for pre-commit.

Acceptance criteria for new SKUs (pre-deploy checklist):
- Perf delta within 8% of benchmark for the target model family.
- Power/cooling validation in targeted pod.
- Burn-in: 48–72 hours with full telemetry (OOM/error rate <0.1%).
- Metrics: tail latency, token cost per 1M tokens, memory/kv retention.

Decision log (open items):
- 2025-09-05: Opted to prioritize Vendor X tranche A for latency-sensitive traffic (Aisha).
- 2025-09-10: Proposal for 20% L40 profile increase to reduce per-token cost for embeddings (Marcus).
- 2025-09-12: Request to trial leasing partner B for 300 units — approved as short-term hedge (Leila).

Risks and mitigations:
- Customs/regulatory slippage (EU): Hold 8% regional safety buffer and prefer staggered shipments.
- Price inflation mid-Q4: negotiate CPI clause for tranches > 500 units.
- Firmware incompatibilities for certain SKUs: require vendor-side OTA and a 7-day validation window in staging.

Open questions / To resolve before commit:
- Finalize cost-per-token comparison table for H100 vs L40 (finance requested by 2025-09-20).
- Confirm apac colocation readiness (network half-duplex test by infra team).
- Decide fallback routing policy for eu-west (<-> us-west) during shortfalls.

Next immediate actions (owner -> due):
- Aisha: draft tranche A PO language + CPI clause by 2025-09-19.
- Marcus: run cost-per-token calc (H100/L40/A100) and share with finance (2025-09-18).
- Leila: negotiate 4-week lease for 300 units and request 2-day hold option (2025-09-17).

Notes to self (working):
- Keep this sheet as the single-source-of-truth for tranche sizing until the procurement notebook is finalized.
- Link relevant JIRA tickets in the procurement PR to maintain traceability.
- If the APAC region requires >25% more bandwidth on arrivals, we should prefer smaller, more frequent shipments to avoid customs hold risk.

Appendix: quick formulas (verbatim)
- required_capacity = ceil(current_demand / target_utilization) - current_active_pool
- tranche_units = round(required_capacity * region_allocation_fraction)

End of sheet.
